name: Run TS
description: Adds the runts agent tool: run a JavaScript/TypeScript snippet with bun inside the agent's workplace (the active execution backend), beside runpy for Python. Stateless per call — nothing survives between calls except files you write into the workspace.
author: Evonic

variables.name: ENABLED
variables.label: Enabled
variables.description: Kill switch. When disabled, runts fails closed without running anything.

variables.name: TIMEOUT_SECONDS
variables.label: Timeout (seconds)
variables.description: Wall-clock limit for one snippet. Clamped to 1..300.

variables.name: MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES
variables.label: Maximum output (bytes)
variables.description: Per-stream cap applied to stdout and stderr before the result is returned. Default 65536 matches the backends' own 64 KB cap.

variables.name: BUN_BIN
variables.label: Bun binary
variables.description: bun executable to invoke inside the workplace. Set an absolute path when bun is not on the workplace PATH (e.g. /home/agent/.bun/bin/bun).
